description: Generates a set of credentials consisting of a user name and password that can be used to access the service specified in the request. These credentials are generated by IAM, and can be used only for the specified service.
mitreAttackSubTechniques: T1098.001 - Account Manipulation: Additional Cloud Credentials

researchLinks.description: Someone Else Is Using Your AI

securityImplications: Attackers might use CreateServiceSpecificCredential to generate long-term service credentials, such as a Bedrock API key, for an identity they control, maintaining access to invoke models independently of the IAM access key.
